toolchain.config_rationale: ESLint 9.x deprecated .eslintrc.*; A1C.1 §3 spec used .eslintrc.cjs which is EOL. Flat config is the only supported format on ESLint 9.x.

final_warning_breakdown.backlog_target: Layer 2/3 (not A1D.1 scope). no-explicit-any is intentional in 90% of cases (3rd-party API payloads). react-hooks/exhaustive-deps warnings are typically false positives in callback wrappers.

manual_fixes_detail.fix: Removed unnecessary `\` before `.` inside character class `[.\d]` → `[.\d]`. Dot inside char class is literal, no escape needed.
Removed `(!collapsed || true) &&` constant-left condition. The `|| true` made the LHS always-truthy, so the `!collapsed` check was dead. Simplified to `topItems.map(...)`.
Rewrote ternary expression-statement `r.isFinal ? finalText += ... : interimText += ...` as `if/else` block. Ternary used for side-effects is anti-idiomatic.
Changed `interface CompareResultEntry extends MethodResult {}` to `type CompareResultEntry = MethodResult;`. Empty interface extending another type is equivalent to aliasing.

verification.acceptance_status: HG-03 ESLint PASS restorable to A1C pilot readiness matrix (deferred to A1D.6 aggregate verdict)
